description.title: Limits of Liability Table
description.summary: This table details the insurer's liability limits for medical expenses related to travel insurance policies, specifically referencing medical flights and pregnancy. It is used to determine the maximum coverage amount for different scenarios.
description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מתארת את מגבלות האחריות של המבטח עבור הוצאות רפואיות הקשורות לפוליסות ביטוח נסיעות, תוך התייחסות ספציפית לטיסות רפואיות ולהריון. ניתן להשתמש בה כדי לקבוע את סכום הכיסוי המקסימלי בתרחישים שונים, עד לסכום של 5,000,000 דולר. הפוליסה First Class מגדירה את מגבלות האחריות עבור הוצאות רפואיות, טיסות רפואיות, הריון עד שבוע 12, וכן מקרים שאינם מכוסים כגון הפלות יזומות ומעקב הריון שגרתי. טבלה זו רלוונטית לפוליסת First Class, דולר, הריון, טיסה רפואית, והוצאות רפואיות.

The Insurer's undertaking under this section is conditioned with the above flight being made by the Insurer and/or anyone on its behalf only up to the Medical Expenses Liability Limit of $ 5,000,000 and subject to the Limits of Liability Table in the Policy. If the flight is not performed by the Insurer and/or anyone on its behalf, the Insurer may decrease the amount of insurance benefits to which the Insured will be entitled to the rate the Insurer would have paid had the flight was performed on its behalf.
For the avoidance of doubt , in the event of a Medical Flight, the plane tickets in  possession of the Insured will be assigned in favor of the Insurer, at the Insurer's request.

טבלה: Limits of Liability Table
This table details the insurer's liability limits for medical expenses related to travel insurance policies, specifically referencing medical flights and pregnancy. It is used to determine the maximum coverage amount for different scenarios.
ממדים: Scenario/Condition (e.g., Medical Flight, Pregnancy), Liability Limit/Coverage Detail

The Insurer's undertaking under this section is conditioned with the above flight being made by the Insurer and/or anyone on its behalf only up to the Medical Expenses Liability Limit of $ 5,000,000 and subject to the Limits of Liability Table in the Policy. If the flight is not performed by the Insurer and/or anyone on its behalf, the Insurer may decrease the amount of insurance benefits to which the Insured will be entitled to the rate the Insurer would have paid had the flight was performed on its behalf.
For the avoidance of doubt , in the event of a Medical Flight, the plane tickets in  possession of the Insured will be assigned in favor of the Insurer, at the Insurer's request.
